notes: 2026-01-15 - Initial discovery: product + platform overview. CTO (R. Meyers) wants low-latency chat agent to power in-app assistants. Mentioned high concurrent sessions (~600) during sync windows.
2026-02-10 - Demo with Jordan + Aisha: showed hosted_api streaming and tool-calling example (calendar + search). Customer liked streaming but asked about p95 guarantees.

2026-02-18 - Security kickoff: Skyline’ security team (Okta + internal infosec) sent questionnaire. Key asks: SSO via SAML (Okta), SOC2 Type II report, log retention policy, option to redact PII from request/response logs.

2026-02-25 - Call (ff_20260225_3b7a): SE deep-dive on latency. Customer target: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for token streaming on standard 512-1024 context; 99th for heavy tool calls acceptable up to 700ms. Asked about streaming jitter and reconnects. Quote: "Streaming must look instantaneous to users."

2026-03-03 - POC scoping call (ff_20260303_8q4m): Agreed 48h perf run using hosted_api with warm cache, two agent flows (simple FAQ stream + multi-tool orchestration including vector search call). Aisha to provision test tokens and share traffic script.

2026-03-05 - Security follow-up: requested SOC2 Type II PDF, pen test summary, and description of how logs can be filtered/hashed at ingestion. They want example retention config and confirmation we can turn off storing full request bodies for hosted_api. (see drive:/security/skyline-hosted-api-questions.xlsx)

2026-03-08 - Pricing discussion: Skyline is price sensitive. Current estimate provided; they want a dedicated option if hosted costs exceed $0.05/token-equivalent at scale. Will revisit after POC throughput numbers.

2026-03-09 - Internal SDR note: prioritize delivering explicit answers on PII redaction + SAML SSO steps. SE to document recommended batch sizes and quantization suggestions for Dedicated if they move later.

General: User transcripts may contain emails/ssns — they must be redacted before retention. Skyline asked: can redaction happen client-side or via managed rule? They prefer managed redaction with proof of removal in logs.
Linked tickets: RED-1423 for POC env setup, RED-1489 for security artifacts delivery.
meeting_summary: Skyline is a mid-market SaaS building an in-app chat assistant. Primary concern: reliable <350ms p95 streaming latency for good UX, plus SOC2/SAML + PII redaction for hosted API. They're open to Dedicated if economics or isolation require it.
